title: Maryland court orders new trial over $3.2 million trust after sisters challenge inheritance
summary_full: A Maryland appeals court has mandated a new trial concerning a $3.2 million trust fund held by three sisters. The court identified procedural errors that prevented two sisters from presenting crucial handwriting evidence regarding the trust. Their claims included accusations of undue influence exerted by their sister, the main beneficiary. The appeals court emphasized issues with the previous trial's allowed testimonies and evidence exclusions.
